title: Scanning Electron Microscopy Protocol
author: Sue Lin
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.zz4f78w

steps.title: Perform Double Fixation
steps.instruction: Fix and post-fix the specimen using glutaraldehyde and osmium tetroxide in phosphate buffer.

substeps.instruction: Fix the specimen with 2.5% glutaraldehyde in phosphate buffer (pH 7.0) for more than 4 hours.
Wash the specimen three times in phosphate buffer.
Post-fix the specimen with 1% OsO4 in phosphate buffer (pH 7.0) for 1 hour.
Wash the specimen three times in phosphate buffer.

steps.title: Dehydrate the Specimen
steps.instruction: Dehydrate the specimen through a graded ethanol series and chemical transitions before critical point drying.

substeps.instruction: Dehydrate using a graded series of ethanol (50%, 70%, 80%, 90%, 95%, and 100%) for 15 to 20 minutes at each step.
Transfer to a mixture of alcohol and iso-amyl acetate (v:v=1:1) for about 30 minutes.
Transfer to pure iso-amyl acetate for about 1 hour.
Perform final dehydration in a Hitachi Model HCP-2 critical point dryer with liquid CO2.

steps.title: Coat and Observe Specimen
steps.instruction: Apply a conductive coating to the dehydrated specimen and perform SEM imaging.

substeps.instruction: Coat the specimen with gold-palladium using an Eiko Model IB5 ion coater (Eiko Engineering Company, Ibaraki, Japan).
Observe the specimen in a Hitachi Model TM-1000 scanning electron microscope (Tokyo, Japan).
